game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf, the merchant wharf: the sailor must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Nested Maze: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches.
theme: Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf: the merchant wharf
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Wharf, repeat each round: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches. Each round, a new pearls challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the route_score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 390 points of pearls by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Nested Maze
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Maze' (Week 3 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Merchant Wharf'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how route_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Merchant Wharf.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
